editorial:
Ever wonder how a wild story about bank robbers and blood-sucking monsters actually gets made? You get a front-row seat to the chaos in this behind-the-scenes look at the first season of the show. It follows the Gecko brothers as they run from the law only to end up in a nightmare bar full of demons. The vibe is high-energy and a bit gritty, giving you a peek at how the crew turned a crazy movie idea into a full TV series without losing that edge. You will see the sweat, the fake blood, and the hard work that goes into making the monsters look scary.

What really hits home is seeing the actors talk about their roles and how they handled the wild action scenes. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the technical talk might feel a bit dry if you just want more monster fights. If you love seeing how movie magic works, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look at those special effects, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. Adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a great move if you are a big fan of the series.
endingExplained: The documentary wraps up by showing the final push to finish the first season. You see the team celebrate their hard work and reflect on how they successfully brought the monsters to life. It ends with a look at the finished product, showing that the risks they took paid off. The final scenes leave you feeling excited for the characters and give you a sense of pride in the creative process behind the scenes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves seeing how special effects and TV shows are created.
